name: The Witch
source: Join the protagonist—an ordinary 18-year-old guy—as he takes on the sinister, mysterious Nexus Corporation, which is determined to capture him, and its secret masters, who seek to turn him into a pawn in their schemes. Find the women who will not only hide him from his pursuers but also help him build a new life in the vast city of Nevermist—a city full of new opportunities, vibrant and beautiful girls, wealthy and powerful women, and handsome men, all waiting to help you explore your sexuality and experience a world of sensual pleasures. But be careful, for on the streets of this city and beneath the canopy of the Misty Forest, new dangers and enemies lie in wait, biding their time to claim the protagonist’s increasingly feminine body for their perverse purposes.
translation: 跟随原本只是普通18岁青年的男主角，迎战阴险神秘、铁了心要将他捕获的“枢轴公司”，以及企图将他变成阴谋棋子的幕后黑手吧。寻觅那些不仅能替他躲避追捕、更能助他在恢弘都市“永雾城”开启新生活的女性——这座城市遍布崭新机遇，青春靓丽的少女、富甲一方的女强人与英俊迷人的男子都在此等候，随时准备带你探索自身情欲、领略感官欢愉的极乐世界。但千万当心：在这座城市的街巷深处与迷雾森林的树冠之下，新的危机与强敌正潜伏暗处伺机而动，企图将男主角日渐女性化的身躯据为己有，用以满足他们变态扭曲的私欲。
